title: Chickpea and spinach curry
summary: A vegan curry of chickpeas, spinach and tomato, finished with light coconut milk and a small bowl of basmati. Freezer peas are not required; the tin of chickpeas does the work.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil in the large saucepan and soften the onion for 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin and turmeric and cook for a minute so the spices don't taste raw.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and crumbled stock cube. Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens, then stir in the coconut milk and spinach until the leaves wilt.
steps.tip: Mash a spoonful of chickpeas against the side of the pan if you want a thicker sauce.

steps.instruction: While the curry simmers, cook the rice in the water with a pinch of salt, covered, for 10 minutes, then leave it to steam off the heat.
Taste the curry and add salt if the stock cube hasn't already seasoned it. Share between bowls with the rice and the coriander.
